question: Should the interface vocabulary of scripts/dossier/schema.json get a `grpc` term? dev-services/temporal-server (the Frontend Service gRPC API on port 7233, which every Temporal SDK uses) and dev-services/temporal-cloud (the Cloud Ops gRPC API) record `rest` and `cli` as the nearest terms and name gRPC in interface_detail.
why: the vocabulary has no gRPC term, so a reader who filters records by interface cannot find an offer whose client API is gRPC; the nearest term was used and the true one named in the record's text
